description:
A member of T.T. STAR (Twinkle Twin Star). As one of the Ark's top pop stars, she is currently enjoying a surge in popularity.
She sticks to a rigorous training regimen which, combined with her talents in songwriting and composition, makes her the most technically capable member of the group. Although she exhibits confidence no matter who she's interacting with and never second-guesses her own thoughts, she is surprisingly mentally fragile.

lines.text: Thank you so much for being here. Hope you're ready for another flawless performance.
You're not skipping meals or anything, right? As much as we appreciate your support, make sure you're taking care of yourself first.
Fan service? Tell me what you'd like and I'll see if we can accommodate.
I think I get now why Anis was able to change. It's because you were by her side, Muse.
If you were satisfied with today's performance, then I must've done really well. That's enough for me.
I want you to come to our next recording. I always do a lot better when you're there. The difference is noticeable.
I have to go to practice soon. How long do I need to stay here?
You seem busy, so feel free to take your time. I just got a great idea for some lyrics anyway.
Since there's no practice room here, I've just been using the gym. I can't let myself get rusty.
I'm surprised that there are people here who recognize me. I'm really glad I never gave up.
Things feel a little quiet around here, don't they? Maybe we should play one of our songs and liven things up.
Hello! We're the two shining stars, Twinkle Twin Star! I'm Prika.
Thank you. I'm feeling pretty good, like I could practice all night.
I just got a great idea for a song.
Being a pop star is more like a marathon than a sprint, and you've been a huge help in keeping me going.
Is this for me? Thank you... I feel like I'm always on the receiving end when it comes to you.
I'll use this as motivation to work harder.
As a token of my thanks, I'm going to deliver the absolute best performance I can.
Now I want to write a song just for you, Muse. You'll help out, right?
I feel like the closer we get, the more inspiration I receive.
I rely on you a lot, you know. Both on stage and off.
Okay... I'll do my best.
Yes, I'm listening.
Heading over there now.
Leave it to me. I've been training for this.
I'm gonna treat this like a performance.
With you here, Muse, I'll be fine.
Just gotta stick to what I practiced.
Doing great so far.
Phew... I need a sec.
One more time. Let's do this.
Everyone, all eyes on me!
Get ready to see T.T. STAR shine!
Let's keep this momentum going!
Nice!
I'm pretty good at this.
That was on point.
Ugh...!
Urgh!
Sorry, I must not have practiced enough...
I'd say our surface debut went pretty well.
This week's schedule? First the practice room, then the recording studio. I'm actually busiest between comebacks.
I'm going to work out. Want to tag along? If I don't keep moving, my body gets all stiff.
Surprisingly, not many fans recognize me when I'm dressed this way. They never expect to run into me in something like this.
Being around you puts me at ease, Muse. It's like all my worries just melt away. Strange, isn't it?
I can't remember the last time I could walk around outside this freely. Thanks for coming out with me.
There's somewhere I'd like to go today, other than the practice room... Will you come with me?
This is starting to feel like too much downtime... Mind if I head in first?
Spending my break just looking at you... isn't so bad at all.
I have to say, wandering around like this without a care is pretty nice. It clears my head too.
There always seems to be something interesting going on around here. I like that you can experience so many different things.
Do you play any instruments, Muse? If you're interested, I could teach you while I have the time off.
I have to keep practicing consistently, even if I'm not actively promoting.
I feel light on my feet. Time to push even harder for my next comeback.
I'm in great shape to stage a comeback right now.
I could probably squeeze in a bit more practice. Don't worry, I won't overdo it.
It feels like you always pick out exactly what I want. I really appreciate it.
What are you into, Muse? I'd love to get you a gift too.
Getting gifts as a pop star is nice... but this isn't so bad either.
You're starting to take up a large part of my daily life. This is a problem...
If I could, I'd want to stay by your side forever. I feel so much more at ease now, because of you.
I want to be a special source of inspiration for you too, Muse.
I hope I can find some new inspiration.
You called, Muse?
Yup, understood.
... I'm a little nervous.
I trust you with all my heart, Muse.
I'll put on a good show for you.
I've had enough practice.
Phew...! Let me catch my breath.
Not bad, right?
One sec, reloading.
All set!
Don't take your eyes off me, Muse!
Don't stop! Keep going!
I'm doing pretty good...!
You saw that? Got 'em!
That's what I'm talking about.
Ugh...!
Damn...!
Ouch!
I'm sorry, I need more practice...
That was a great experience. This could be inspiration for my next song.
